message.content: {"verdict": "compliant", "citations": ["rbi-13157"], "confidence": 1.0, "rationale": "Clause 3.4 exactly mirrors paragraph 16 of the RBI (Commercial Banks - Interest Rate on Deposits) Directions, 2025, which mandates that unclaimed proceeds of a matured term deposit attract interest at the savings account rate or the contracted rate on the matured TD, whichever is lower."}
